_note: The Dubai Life Marathon (weekly, free). Mirrored in supabase/migrations/*_marathon.sql: the Friday 19:00 GST start, the 15-minute race window, the course length, the top speed and the prizes (checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs). The course plays in game metres; the distance shown is scaled (×10) so the full course reads as a marathon. Locals run alongside for company but never enter or rank. You control the run: a stick for direction and pace, a sprint button, and stamina; water stations, crowd boosts and obstacles sit on the road. Only maxSpeed, the course, the window and the prizes are enforced by the server.
name: Dubai Life Marathon
